concepts.prompt: Long straight stone terrace retaining wall module with a built-in stair for a high cliff-top sky city, 12 metres long, 4 metres tall and about 3 metres deep. A tall battered retaining wall of coursed pale limestone ashlar blocks with buttress pilasters; a straight flight of broad stone steps runs diagonally up along the front face from ground level at one end to the top terrace at the other end. A continuous carved stone balustrade parapet with small round balusters and square posts runs along the top edge and follows the stair, like the bridge reference. One small pointed-arch niche with a gold lantern bracket in the wall face and one royal-blue banner with gold trim and a pale wing emblem hanging on the wall. Flat walkable top surface and flat base. Straight modular ends so pieces can be placed side by side. Same refined castle-town stone family as the gate and bridge references. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no cast background, no people. Materials: pale warm-grey weathered limestone (#9a8f80 to #b8ad9c, never pure white) in coursed ashlar blocks with soft moss in the joints; slate-blue roof tile (#3d4a66), honey-coloured timber only for doors and shutters, royal-blue banner fabric with a small gold accent and pale wing emblem. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere. No half-timbering, no cream plaster, no thatch. Flat ground contact at the base.
concepts.verdict: CHOSEN (view 0 only): strong 3/4 view of buttressed limestone retaining wall, diagonal stair with balustrade, top balustrade parapet, arch niche, gold lantern bracket, blue wing banner; view 1 rejected because it split the piece into two separate objects
